ocal snowmobile clubs are the
strength and backbone of the sport, not
only in Illinois but all across the snow-
belt. All of the trails in Illinois operated
on private lands are the direct result of
local club efforts that involve obtaining
landowner permission, trail marking and
grooming.Through the unified voice and
efforts of the many individuals working
within their respective clubs, the sport
of snowmobiling continues to flourish.
Snowmobiling is a very social sport,
offering more fun and personal enjoy-
ment when done with the right group
rather than alone. So join a club and get
involved.
F
ounded in 1972, the Illinois Assoc-
iation of Snowmobile Clubs (IASC) is
a not-for-profit corporation whose
membership is made up of local snow-
mobile clubs throughout Illinois.The
primary purpose of the IASC is the
promotion of the safety education
program, general promotion of the
sport of snowmobiling, assistance in
organizing new snowmobile clubs,
the establishment of a snowmobile
information resources center,
establishment of more interconnected
snowmobile trails, and any other
programs that are of common interest
to snowmobilers and snowmobile clubs
on a statewide basis.
